question: Which prestigious theatre awards took place on 6 April 2025 at the Royal Albert Hall?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Laurence Olivier Awards**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Laurence Olivier Awards**, widely known as the **Olivier Awards**, are scheduled to take place on **6 April 2025**.
 
• The prestigious ceremony is traditionally held at the **Royal Albert Hall** in **London**, which has served as the home for the awards since **2017**.
 
• These awards are organized and presented annually by the **Society of London Theatre (SOLT)** to recognize excellence in professional theatre in **London**.
 
• The **2025** event continues the tradition of honoring the best of the **West End**, covering a wide array of categories including **plays**, **musicals**, **dance**, and **opera**.
